title: Get Ready for the Next Euromillions Superdraw
heading: New Euromillions Superdraw Announced!
description: Don't miss your chance to win big in the upcoming Euromillions Superdraw! Mark September 27 on your lottery calendar now!
author: Lotto Express Marketing
body_html:
Friday 27th September marks the date for the next Euromillions Superdraw. Lottery enthusiasts around the world are eagerly anticipating this not-to-be-missed event.

Euromillions Superdraws occur approximately four times per calendar year. September 27th will mark the fourth preannounced Superdraw of 2024. The Division 1 jackpot on this date will be an astounding €130 million – promising life-changing winnings for the fortunate winner(s).

What is the Euromillions Superdraw?

It’s an extraordinary event featuring a special SUPER-SIZED minimum jackpot guarantee. Unlike regular draws, the Euromillions Superdraw offers a minimum guaranteed jackpot of €130 million regardless of whether there was a carryover from the preceding Euromillions draw.

Euromillions Superdraw = Super Jackpot.

The equation is simple: One of the unique features of the Euromillions is the gameplay. Players select five numbers from a range of 1 to 50 and two additional “Lucky Star” numbers from a pool of 1 to 12. To win the jackpot, players must match all five main numbers and both Lucky Star numbers.

Euromillions provides multiple secondary prizes, with 13 prize tiers. The amounts vary based on the number of matched numbers and Lucky Star numbers.

Euromillions

Euromillions has been around since 2004. The game is currently available to be purchased locally in Andorra, Austria, Belgium, France (including overseas regions and collectivities), Ireland, the Isle of Man, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg, Monaco, Portugal, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom.

International players can purchase their Euromillions Superdraw tickets at LottoExpress.com

Euromillions Superdraws offers something truly special — a guaranteed Jackpot of €130 million! Don’t miss your chance to be part of this thrilling event and aim for the life-changing Division 1 Jackpot Prize.

The Countdown is ON!

Get ready for an exciting and potentially life-changing experience in the upcoming Euromillions Superdraw. The draw takes place Friday September 27 – giving you the perfect opportunity to participate and have a chance for the incredible €130 million jackpot.
